CustomField.label: Aide conseiller
CustomField.description: Internal guidance shown to the agent on this node (not read to the client): what to check, how to decide, which answer to pick. Distinct from Texte, which is the client-facing content.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Consigne interne au conseiller (non lue au client) : quoi vérifier, comment choisir la réponse.
